summary: The reconcile start-completion wake test holds the next pass until the launch worker has finished: admission's own signal_changed can wake that pass first, and on a loaded host it found the launch still running, applied nothing and rested, so the test saw [1, 1] instead of [1, 2].

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.
